name: pipe-fitting
description: Hex nipple, 1-inch male pipe thread both ends, chrome-plated brass (Hornbach article 7154578, sold as a 1-inch double nipple)

frame.origin: centre of volume, which is the geometric centre by symmetry
frame.z: the axis of the part; the two ends are identical, so the sign is arbitrary
frame.x: from the axis towards a corner of the hex

symmetry.rotation: 6-fold about z (60 degree steps), from the hex; the thread helix breaks it only by an axial shift of pitch/6 = 0.385 mm per step, below the camera's resolution
symmetry.flip: end for end (180 degrees about x) up to the thread phase: both ends are identical

source.kind: generated from calliper measurements of the real part; no downloaded geometry

to_verify: end and bore chamfers, by eye against reference photos (not included)
mass on a scale (brass would give about the value printed by the build)
